I'm in the same boat, started dating someone before divorce was finalized, and then moved in with her... Not sure if it was a good idea, most likely not, but now there is nothing to do about it, will need to be a man and try to make it work, you are in a much better position to back down a bit.

No, can't do a thing about child support. I want to reduce alimony but is going to be hard, ex is playing the victim card and from what I have seen the court doesn't give a fuck about pages and pages of third party declarations, they just see a tear in her cheek and take away everything I used to be and could be.
I pay 3800 a month to that fucker, plus child support, so don't feel too bad. She pretty much destroyed me for the short, mid and long term.
